primary_metric: Macro mean recovery@13 over cases after averaging the three repeat seeds, mirroring the SZH 3d baseline protocol (13 queries per task, repeat seeds 17/42/2026).
primary_control: skeleton_complete_forced at the parent-strata v1 budget of 16 calls
split_rule: The frozen 13-case causal split is kept so pairing with the audited v1 controls is preserved. For seeds 17 and 42 the first 13 raw calls of the frozen skeleton-forced v1 test run are reused verbatim (identical prompts and per-attempt seeds, verified by request digest); only seed 2026 uses fresh inference (13 cases x 13 calls). Controls are compared at their first 13 calls, replayed from runs/parent-test raw.
disclosure: The test split has been used by the parent-strata v1, skeleton v1 and skeleton-forced v1 studies. This aligned-budget study reuses the same cases and seeds 17/42 responses without regeneration; no method or sampling hyperparameter was changed or tuned on these results, only the budget prefix and an additional repeat seed were applied post-freeze.
method_definition: Identical to the frozen skeleton_complete_forced method of experiments/parent-skeleton-forced.json: forced-backbone hierarchical skeleton completion with budget-enforced assembly. Only the per-case budget (13 instead of 16) and the repeat-seed set (17/42/2026 instead of 17/42) are aligned to the SZH 3d baseline protocol.
